mapper.select: SELECT cbpd.status, cbpd.seq, cbr.new_seq, cbr.user_code, cbpd2.rest_date, cu.USER_NM, cu.FIRM_NM, IFNULL(cu.USER_PHONE, '-') AS USER_PHONE, cbc.charge_name as ex_charge_name, IFNULL(cbc2.charge_name, "해지") AS charge_name, IFNULL(ROUND(cbc.amount*cbc.sub_period*1.1), 0) AS ex_amount, IFNULL(ROUND(cbc2.amount*cbc2.sub_period *1.1), 0) AS new_amount, cbpd.payment_base_amount + cbpd.payment_base_vat + cbr.refund_amount AS balance, DATE_FORMAT(cbpd.expire_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expire_date, IFNULL(cbr.refund_amount, 0) AS refund_amount, IFNULL(cbr.refund_card, 0) AS refund_card, IFNULL(cbr.refund_amount, 0) + IFNULL(cbr.refund_card, 0) AS refund_cash, cbr.refund_user_name, cbr.refund_bank, cbr.refund_account, cbpd.imp_uid FROM CBCI_BILLING_REFUND cbr LEFT JOIN CBCI_BILLING_PAYMENT_DETAIL cbpd ON cbpd.seq = cbr.seq LEFT JOIN CBCI_BILLING_PAYMENT_DETAIL cbpd2 ON cbpd2.seq = cbr.new_seq LEFT JOIN CBCI_USER cu ON cbpd.user_code = cu.USER_CODE LEFT JOIN CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE cbc ON cbpd.charge_code = cbc.charge_code LEFT JOIN CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE cbc2 ON cbpd2.charge_code = cbc2.charge_code WHERE cbpd2.seq = #{seq}
mapper.update: UPDATE CBCI_BILLING_REFUND SET refund_date = now(), status = 'C' WHERE seq = #{seq}
UPDATE CBCI_BILLING_PAYMENT_DETAIL SET status = IF(status = 'RR', 'RC', 'CC') WHERE seq = #{new_seq}
